macros.name: address
macros.doc: \author, \address and \date are markup commands which store global values used to build the letterhead.

macros.name: ccname
macros.doc: \enclname and \ccname are set to {encl}, respectively {cc} by default.

macros.name: closing
macros.doc: The \closing macro stores its argument in \valediction for later use.

macros.name: encl
macros.doc: This command is a shortcut for \ps{\enclname}{...} and takes one mandatory argument.

macros.name: makelabels
macros.doc: \makelabels creates an addtional envelope page with only the recipient’s address and the sender’s return address.

macros.name: object
macros.doc: This command will simply output the text given in its argument, followed by a \bigskip.

macros.name: stopbreaks
macros.doc: \stopbreaks will try to prevent all page breaks after its invocation.

macros.name: titlehead
macros.doc: \titlehead controls the vertical placement of the first baseline of the letterhead.

macros.name: titlemargin
macros.doc: \titlemargin and \titlewidth control the horizontal position and width of the letterhead.

macros.name: titlewidth
macros.doc: \titlemargin and \titlewidth control the horizontal position and width of the letterhead.

envs.name: letter
envs.doc: The letter environment actually creates the letter with its letterhead and all the needed layout.
